findings: All13 bound input hashes match; only the new test and three proposal files differ. Runtime and PR253 source inputs are unchanged. Reviewer did not import/run the test,application or native code and did not apply the patch.

Expected offset90 is decoded from accepted original root common/offset and32 child+0x41 bytes in SHAecec70d64abcfedd06ea1146462b6f7d86e35a3e8b77652f5cea0587b058c957. The live helper does not synthesize the native oracle.

Actual production birth observation extends the existing RNG-write observer. Every RNG assignment is forwarded unchanged. On the pending effect, the one-time animation setter first restores its original/default ordinary data descriptor with the assigned animation, then reads detached birth values. The synchronous producer has no intervening consumer requiring a different property value. Finally restores only still-owned descriptors and preserves the last actual RNG value; observation errors fail the regression.

The test requires the exact producer turn,age0,state3,zero velocity,three draws,first-draw lifetime,speed60 and authored XY,32 births per fresh enabled stone. Missions1/2/3 cover8/8/16 stones and1024 births with phases/counters/RNG diagnostics emitted before height assertions. This is fixed-step production-caller evidence, not public-control rendered evidence.

Proposed runtime delta creates one position after the existing effect9 counter increment and before the child loop: short(max(short(point.h),current terrain ground)+90). Existing createSpellTrail copies the position and keeps its child clamp. Allocation/draw order and parent stone data are unchanged. The expression matches the original signed root clamp-before-offset primitive.

Old-stone origin recovery remains excluded. The existing estimated old-stone point may pass through the corrected primitive without becoming a recovered native terrain-history input. No complete startup/raster/RNG-history parity claim is made.
